scenes.title: Hidden Mind
scenes.text: Your brain hides most of what it decides from you. Ninety five percent of behavior runs on autopilot.
scenes.hook: 95% OF YOUR BRAIN IS ON AUTOPILOT

scenes.title: Magic Number
scenes.text: You can hold about seven things in working memory at once. That is why phone numbers are short.

scenes.title: Quick Judge
scenes.text: People form a first impression in a fraction of a second, before you even finish speaking.

scenes.title: We Forget
scenes.text: Forgetting is not failure. Your brain deletes noise so the useful stuff stays sharp and ready.

scenes.title: Best Ideas
scenes.text: Your best ideas arrive when you stop focusing. Daydreaming lets distant thoughts connect in new ways.

scenes.title: Social Proof
scenes.text: When unsure, you copy the crowd. That is why a busy restaurant feels safer than an empty one.

scenes.title: Rewire
scenes.text: Every repeated thought strengthens a path in your brain. You can literally rewire yourself by practicing.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Your mind is more flexible than you think. Which habit would you rewire first, starting today?
